verdict.rationale: The evidence covers model download progress, hardware-accelerated inference such as the Hexagon NPU and Metal, and explicit local-versus-cloud execution. None of it documents an AI assistant or tool that recommends a local model based on the user's hardware and task before download. Model selection guidance is a fair question for an on-device AI SDK/CLI, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can rely on an AI assistant to recommend which local model best fits my hardware and task before I download it
